modules.title: Residence, work locations and state/local obligations
Employment, tips, overtime and equity pay
modules.screen: Did the taxpayer or spouse have employee compensation, tips, benefits or employer equity activity?

modules.title: Interest, dividends and investment accounts
modules.screen: Were there taxable bank, brokerage, bond or other investment accounts or investment income?

modules.title: Sales, exchanges and adjusted basis
modules.screen: Were capital assets, securities, personal property or business assets sold, exchanged, redeemed or disposed of?

modules.title: Digital assets and wallet reconciliation
modules.screen: Did the taxpayer or spouse own, buy, transfer, receive or dispose of any digital assets, including stablecoins and NFTs?

modules.title: Retirement contributions, distributions and conversions
modules.screen: Were there retirement contributions, distributions, rollovers, Roth conversions, inherited accounts or unresolved retirement-account issues?

modules.title: Self-employment and closely held business
modules.screen: Was there a trade, business, freelancing, consulting, gig work, personal-property rental business or ownership of a disregarded entity?

modules.title: Rental real estate and royalties
modules.screen: Was property rented, available for rent, converted to/from rental use, or held with suspended rental losses?

modules.title: Pass-through interests and K-1s
modules.screen: Was there any partnership, S corporation, trust, estate, fund, PTP or other interest that issued or could issue a K-1?

modules.title: Other income and nontaxable receipts
modules.screen: Were there benefits, unemployment, Social Security, alimony, winnings, awards, canceled payments, settlements or any other receipts not yet categorized?

modules.title: Sale of a principal residence
modules.screen: Did the taxpayer or spouse sell or otherwise dispose of a home, or receive Form 1099-S for one?

modules.title: Adjustments and special deductions
modules.screen: Were there student-loan interest, educator expenses, alimony paid, qualifying moving costs, early-savings penalties or other income adjustments?

modules.title: Standard versus itemized deductions
modules.screen: Were there medical costs, taxes, mortgage/investment interest, gifts, casualty losses or other potentially itemized deductions?

modules.title: Charitable contributions and appraisals
modules.screen: Were cash or noncash charitable gifts made, or are charitable carryovers available?

modules.title: Education, scholarships and 529 coordination
modules.screen: Did anyone in the tax household attend school, receive scholarships, use a 529/Coverdell account, or claim education benefits?

modules.title: Dependent care and adoption
modules.screen: Were there care expenses, dependent-care employer benefits, adoption costs or adoption benefits?

modules.title: Marketplace health coverage
modules.screen: Did anyone in the tax household have Marketplace coverage, receive advance premium tax credits, or expect a 1095-A?

modules.title: HSAs, MSAs, FSAs and ABLE accounts
modules.screen: Did anyone hold or use an HSA, MSA, FSA or ABLE account, or have unresolved contribution/distribution issues?

modules.title: Home energy improvements
modules.screen: Were energy-efficiency improvements, solar/battery/other clean-energy systems or prior energy-credit carryovers involved?

modules.title: Vehicle credits and loan-interest deduction
modules.screen: Was a vehicle purchased, a vehicle tax credit transferred/claimed, eligible loan interest paid, or charging equipment installed?

modules.title: International status, income, accounts and entities
modules.screen: Was there foreign residence, work, income, tax, an account/signature authority, foreign assets/entities/trusts/gifts, or expatriation?

modules.title: Canceled debt, foreclosure and bankruptcy
modules.screen: Was debt canceled, forgiven, settled, foreclosed, repossessed or discharged in bankruptcy?

modules.title: Casualty, theft and disaster relief
modules.screen: Was there property damage, theft, a disaster-related loss, insurance recovery or disaster election?

modules.title: Gifts, inheritances and estate-related obligations
modules.screen: Were substantial gifts made/received, trust transfers, inheritances, estate distributions or gift-tax elections involved?

modules.title: Household workers and payroll
modules.screen: Was a nanny, caregiver, housekeeper, gardener or other household worker paid directly?

modules.title: Farming, fishing and natural resources
modules.screen: Was there farming, fishing, agricultural rental, timber, mineral/royalty activity or farm-specific carryover/election?

modules.title: Military, clergy and uncommon situations
modules.screen: Was there military/clergy service, tribal-specific income, expatriate compensation, reportable transactions or another uncommon federal tax issue?
